note: The module provides two entity_reference field formatters: entity_reference_facet_link ('Facet link', renders links) and entity_reference_facet_url ('Facet URL', renders the URL). The single formatter setting is 'facet' (a facets_facet entity id), schema field.formatter.settings.entity_reference_facet_link. Configuration lives in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> content.<field>.type + settings.facet. No admin page, no permissions, no Drush. Requires the Facets module (enabled on this site) at render time. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real display config using namespaced field_erfl_* entity_reference fields on the Article content type; the facet id is stored as a string and does not require a live facet for config introspection.

evals.prompt: I have a taxonomy term reference field on my nodes and a Search API + Facets search page. I want the terms shown on a node to link to that search page filtered by the term, not to the term's own page. Which module and field formatter do this?
evals.expected_output: Entity Reference Facet Link. On the field's Manage display, choose the 'Facet link' formatter (entity_reference_facet_link) and select the facet to link to. It links each referenced value to the faceted search page filtered by that value.

evals.prompt: What are the two field formatters provided by the entity_reference_facet_link module, and how do they differ?
evals.expected_output: 'Facet link' (entity_reference_facet_link) renders each referenced entity's label as a link to the facet page; 'Facet URL' (entity_reference_facet_url) outputs just the facet URL as markup. Both apply to entity_reference fields.

evals.prompt: Does the entity_reference_facet_link module work on its own? What must be installed and configured for it to do anything, and what setting must you choose on the formatter?
evals.expected_output: No. It requires the Facets module and an existing faceted search page (e.g. Search API + Facets + a view) whose facet targets the field. On the formatter you must select the target facet (the 'facet' setting). Links are built by the facet's own URL processor, so they match Facets Pretty Paths automatically.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity reference field named field_erfl_ref. Inspect the live default display configuration and state which field formatter it is using.
evals.expected_output: field_erfl_ref uses the entity_reference_facet_link ('Facet link') formatter in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_erfl_ref2 is displayed with the Facet link formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and state the id of the facet that field is configured to link to.
evals.expected_output: It links to the facet erfl_news_topics: core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_erfl_ref2.settings.facet = erfl_news_topics.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity reference field field_erfl_task that currently uses the default label formatter on its default display. Using the entity_reference_facet_link module, change the default view display so that field is rendered with the 'Facet link' formatter. Apply the change to the live site.

On this Drupal site, the Article field field_erfl_pick already uses the 'Facet link' formatter but no facet is selected. Configure that formatter so the field links to the facet whose id is erfl_hard_facet. Apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: content.field_erfl_pick.type is entity_reference_facet_link and settings.facet is erfl_hard_facet.
